segments.name: $group
segments.sql: CREATE TABLE "$group" (uid TEXT PRIMARY KEY, doc_id TEXT NOT NULL, "group" TEXT, content TEXT, meta TEXT, global_meta TEXT, type INTEGER, number INTEGER, kb_id TEXT, excluded_embed_metadata_keys TEXT, excluded_llm_metadata_keys TEXT, parent TEXT, answer TEXT, image_keys TEXT)

segments.name: $group_fts
segments.sql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE "$group_fts" USING fts5(uid UNINDEXED, content, tokenize='unicode61')

segments.name: $group_fts_config
segments.sql: CREATE TABLE '$group_fts_config'(k PRIMARY KEY, v) WITHOUT ROWID

segments.name: $group_fts_content
segments.sql: CREATE TABLE '$group_fts_content'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, c0, c1)

segments.name: $group_fts_data
segments.sql: CREATE TABLE '$group_fts_data'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, block BLOB)

segments.name: $group_fts_docsize
segments.sql: CREATE TABLE '$group_fts_docsize'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sz BLOB)

segments.name: $group_fts_idx
segments.sql: CREATE TABLE '$group_fts_idx'(segid, term, pgno, PRIMARY KEY(segid, term)) WITHOUT ROWID
